title: Sughra Haaye Sughra
body:
SUGHRA… HAYE SUGHRA… AKBER TERE BHAAI AB NA RAHA…..
KAB SEHRA BAAND KEY AYEGA
KAB CHAND SA CHEHRA DIKHAYEGA
THA BAHEN KO YE ARMAAN.….
<<DIVIDER>>
SEENEY PE SINA AKBER KEY LAGI
AANKHAO KI BASARATH MERI GAYI
DIL TOOT GAYA MERA….. SUGHRA… HAYE SUGHRA… AATA BHI NAHI THA KUCH BHI NAZAR
HAR GAAM PE LAGTI THI THOKAR
<<DIVIDER>>
DIKHTA BHI NA THA RASTA….. SUGHRA… HAYE SUGHRA…… AAYI JO SADA AKBER KI MUJHE
MAT PUCHO RUN KO GAYA KAISE
KHOON ROTA RAHA BABA….. SUGHRA… HAYE SUGHRA… JAB LAASHAE AKBER PAR POUNCHA
THA KHOON MEIN GHALTA LAAL MERA
<<DIVIDER>>
MEIN DEKH NAHI PAAYA…. SUGHRA… HAYE SUGHRA…..
HAATAO PE UTAHAYA LAASHE JAWAN
CHAYA THA MERI AANKHAO MEIN DHUA
SAMBHALA BHI NAHI JAATA….. SUGHRA… HAYE SUGHRA… JAB UTHTA NAHI LAASHE AKBER
<<DIVIDER>>
BACCHAO KO SADA DI RORO KAR
SAB LEKEY CHALE LAASHA….. SUGHRA… HAYE SUGHRA… QAIMEY ME JUHIN POUNCHA LAASHA
US WAQT SOHAIL EK GULTHA BAPA
SUB KARTE YE NOUHA….. SUGHRA… HAYE SUGHRA…
